asked.item: Error 'This invoice can no longer be paid on Stripe'
Must I pay the old invoice before using Blotato again?
Card was declined, what to do

verdict.reason: The help page covers this exact Stripe message, says the old invoice need not be paid, and gives the steps to subscribe again.

steps.text: That message means the invoice expired and Stripe closed it, so you cannot pay that specific invoice anymore.
You do not need to pay the old expired invoice.
Go to Settings > Billing, click View Billing Portal, and update your payment method, adding a different card if your current card was declined.
Select the plan you want and confirm checkout.
Subscribing again generates a new invoice and reactivates your account.
